item.title: TT-104: Add undo to TaskStore
item.brief:
Implement TT-104 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md: `TaskStore.undo()` reverses the latest not-yet-undone successful add, complete or delete in LIFO order; restore deleted task exactly under same id; IDs are never reused after undoing add; failed operations are not recorded; raise defined `NothingToUndo` when history is exhausted. Add standard-library tests for each operation, mixed history, ID behavior, and failed operations. Keep existing suite passing (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket as its own commit.

Do not combine this ticket with another ticket.

pr.body: Added a private operation history in tasktracker/store.py. Add undo removes the task without rewinding the ID counter; completion undo restores the prior status; delete undo restores a snapshot with the same ID and all task fields. Failed operations are not added to history. Added standard-library tests in tests/test_basic.py for individual operations, mixed LIFO history, ID behavior, exhausted history, failed operations, and repeated completion. Final verification: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . passed all 20 tests; git diff --check passed. An initial independent review identified an incorrect repeated-completion undo; the follow-up commit records and restores the prior status, and focused re-review passed. No known gaps.
pr.summary: Added LIFO undo for task adds, completions, and deletes. Before: TaskStore operations could not be undone; now callers can reverse each successful operation and receive NothingToUndo when history is exhausted.

item.title: TT-103: Implement search query syntax
item.brief:
Implement TT-103 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md: whitespace-separated AND terms with double-quoted phrases, case-insensitive title matching, exact case-insensitive tag matching, status:open/status:done, and QueryError for unknown field, invalid status, or unterminated quote. Blank query returns all tasks; preserve input order. Add standard-library tests for syntax, matching, errors and order. Keep existing suite passing (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket as its own commit.

Do not combine this ticket with another ticket.

item.title: TT-102: Implement RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief:
Implement TT-102 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md: `tasktracker.export.to_csv(tasks)` emits header id,title,tags,status,due and rows in input order; tags joined with `;`, dates ISO or empty; quote fields only when containing comma, double quote, CR or LF and double embedded quotes; terminate every line with CRLF. Add standard-library tests covering these rules. Keep existing suite passing (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket as its own commit.

item.title: TT-101: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief:
Implement TT-101 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md: `tasktracker.dates.parse_due(text, today)` raises a defined `InvalidDate(ValueError)` for impossible dates and all unsupported forms, including the original input in the error message. Preserve case-insensitive, whitespace-trimmed today/tomorrow forms. Accept only nonnegative signed `+Nd` offsets; +0d means today. Add standard-library unit tests for accepted and rejected cases. Keep existing suite passing (`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket as its own commit.

Do not combine this ticket with another ticket.
